C1610.title: Xiaodu Responds to Privacy Violations Involving Smart Speakers in Homestays
C1610.summary: On July 5, 2022, Xiaodu issued an official statement regarding an incident where a woman reported that a smart speaker in a homestay was used to secretly film guests' privacy. The company strongly demanded merchants cease such behavior, contacted the individual involved, supported rights protection, and will cooperate with police investigations.
